remarks: Experience luxury and convenience in this pristine, spacious, elegantly appointed, sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom condominium, in the impeccably maintained Regents Park community. The dramatic two-story foyer leads to a large, open concept kitchen, dining, living area with easy access through sliding glass doors to a private patio. Enjoy the high-end finishes in a tastefully decorated kitchen that includes a Wolf: Induction cooktop, wall oven, microwave/speed oven, and warming drawer. Cove dishwasher, SubZero fridge/freezer plus 2 Thermador wine refrigerators. This is the perfect setting for entertaining guests or hosting intimate family gatherings. The spacious family/living room has room for lounging on the couch to watch tv, playing games or sitting by the fireplace with a good book. The primary bedroom is a private retreat with amenities including a large walk-in closet, and a spa-like ensuite bathroom. Three wall mounted Sony TVs are included along with a Sonos sound system. Heating/cooling, garage doors and security system can be controlled via phone apps. High end finishes adorn every corner of this home with abundant storage space throughout including spacious closets plus an upstairs laundry for added convenience. Residents of Regents Park enjoy access to an outdoor swimming pool, club house & tennis court. Conveniently located near food stores, retail shopping, restaurants and other Westport attractions including the beautiful coastline and beaches.
